description: 该技能用于 smri-skill 相关工作流。适合在需要执行、检查或组织此类任务时启用；核心能力包括：Use this skill whenever the user wants to process structural MRI (sMRI) such as T1w/T2w/FLAIR for brain extraction, bias correction, tissue segmentation (GM/WM/CSF), registration to MNI, cortical/subcortical parcellation, cortical thickness/volumetry (FreeS...

provides.label: sMRI 结构成像工作流 受约束方案
provides.description: 依据 smri-skill/SKILL.md 生成结构化步骤；当前为规划型方法，不对应可直接执行的 runner。
provides.default_reason: 该规划方法包含从 SKILL.md 提取的任务选项、脚本或命令依据。

source_references.label: 已提取 5 条参考命令

command_references.command: sudo apt-get install -y tcsh bc perl tar libgomp1 build-essential wget vim-common libxmu-dev libxi-dev libxt-dev libx11-dev libglu1-mesa-dev libjpeg62-dev

input_slots.label: 输入数据集
input_slots.description: 可从已登记数据集、授权路径或上游步骤选择；具体格式仍以该 Skill 的说明为准。

output_slots.label: 规划输出
output_slots.description: 该 planning 步骤声明的预期产物；只有接入 runner 后才会实际生成。

parameters.label: 任务/方法范围
parameters.description: 选项来自该 Skill 的“Quick Reference (Common sMRI Tasks → Delegation Map)”章节；这是规划约束，不代表已经存在执行器。

options.label: DICOM → NIfTI
options.description: Convert DICOM series to NIfTI (+ JSON)；dcm2nii；T1w.nii.gz, T2w.nii.gz, FLAIR.nii.gz, .json（来源：SKILL.md:L59）

options.label: Organize to BIDS
options.description: Create valid BIDS layout (anat/)；bids-organizer；bids/sub-/anat/sub-T1w.nii.gz etc.（来源：SKILL.md:L60）

options.label: Fast structural preprocessing
options.description: Brain extraction, bias correction, tissue segmentation, MNI registration；fsl-tool (fslanat, BET/FAST/FLIRT/FNIRT)；brain mask, tissue maps, transforms, QC（来源：SKILL.md:L61）

options.label: FreeSurfer Autorecon1 (volumetric preprocessing)
options.description: Image conversion, motion correction, intensity normalization, registration to Talairach, bias correction, skull stripping；freesurfer-tool (recon-all -autorecon1)；orig.mgz, T1.mgz, brainmask.mgz, transforms/talairach.xfm（来源：SKILL.md:L62）

options.label: FreeSurfer Autorecon2 (subcortical segmentation & surface extraction)
options.description: Tissue classification, white matter segmentation, surface tessellation, topology repair, white matter & pial surface generation；freesurfer-tool (recon-all -autorecon2)；?h.orig, ?h.white, ?h.pial, aseg.mgz, wm.mgz, surface QC（来源：SKILL.md:L63）

options.label: FreeSurfer Autorecon3 (spherical registration & parcellation)
options.description: Spherical surface registration, cortical parcellation (Desikan-Killiany, Destrieux, DKT), anatomical statistics extraction, Brodmann area mapping；freesurfer-tool (recon-all -autorecon3)；?h.sphere.reg, ?h.aparc.annot, stats/?h.aparc.stats, ROI morphology tables（来源：SKILL.md:L64）

options.label: Full FreeSurfer pipeline (all 3 stages)
options.description: Complete T1/T2 preprocessing with optional T2-pial refinement；freesurfer-tool (recon-all -all -T2pial)；Full FreeSurfer subject directory with surfaces, atlases, stats（来源：SKILL.md:L65）

options.label: Surface-based morphometry (quick)
options.description: Cortical surfaces, parcellation, thickness, aseg/aparc stats (simplified)；freesurfer-tool；FreeSurfer subject dir, stats tables（来源：SKILL.md:L66）

options.label: HCP-grade structural pipeline
options.description: PreFreeSurfer → FreeSurfer → PostFreeSurfer；hcppipeline-tool；HCP-style derivatives, surfaces, QC（来源：SKILL.md:L67）

options.label: BIDS anatomical derivatives (standardized)
options.description: Run BIDS-App anatomical-only workflow；fmriprep-tool (--anat-only)；BIDS derivatives + QC report（来源：SKILL.md:L68）

options.label: WMH lesion segmentation
options.description: Segment WMH from FLAIR+T1；wmh-segmentation (+ docker-env-manager if Docker ops needed)；WMH mask NIfTI + run log（来源：SKILL.md:L69）

options.label: ROI-wise feature extraction
options.description: Extract ROI stats from derived maps (GM prob, WMH mask, thickness maps in NIfTI, cortical thickness, surface-based stats)；nilearn-tool (or fsl-tool fslstats, FreeSurfer mrisanatomicalstats)；roistats.csv, morphology tables（来源：SKILL.md:L70）

parameters.label: 工作流范围
parameters.description: 选择只做预处理、提取特征或规划端到端模态流程。

parameters.label: 包含质量控制
parameters.description: 在流程方案中保留输入检查、中间 QC 和结果核验步骤。

parameters.label: 伪影处理策略
parameters.description: 选择保守标记、自动校正或排除受影响数据。

parameters.label: 标准空间
parameters.description: 规划空间标准化目标；原生空间不会应用模板归一化。

parameters.label: 平滑尺度
parameters.description: 按模态解释为空间或时间平滑尺度；0 表示关闭。

parameters.label: 计算线程数
parameters.description: 为支持并行的软件规划线程数量。
